notes: OBSERVED: DSH 0.1.5-rc.2 records a background Bash launch and terminal tool-jobs notice. The daemon holds working after the first turn until that notice, then settles ready after its completion turn. The scoped test TestDSHBackgroundReleaseFollowsTerminalNotice reads this recording and fails if ready precedes the terminal notice. The two BGPROC_OK replies are distinct: the first ends the requested launch turn; the second is the normal tool-jobs wake completion.

transcript_assertions.name: background launch uses the timed proof command
first turn ends with literal acknowledgement
background job reaches persisted terminal notice
at least one completed turn boundary

text: The real DSH UUID session appears in ready
The DSH session.lock writer PID binds to the same real session
The background-job prompt drives the real session ready to working
After the terminal tool-jobs notice and its completion turn, the same session settles to final ready. TestDSHBackgroundReleaseFollowsTerminalNotice binds this release to the durable notice.
